item_bbba951234c6ce99.title: jedi-master-council/agentic-security-demos
item_bbba951234c6ce99.summary: Set of hands-on demos for agentic AI security: blind verification, AIBOM, eval invariants, authority confinement, recon/malware/LFI/SSRF/scan — offline only.

item_ba5f0aad4ad91fbb.title: open-agent-security/openaidr
item_ba5f0aad4ad91fbb.summary: OpenAIDR — session collection for AI coding agents. Reads what agents write to disk and normalises it into one session model.

item_6a113c542382fd93.title: bonjoski/fabrial
item_6a113c542382fd93.summary: Sovereign AI agent security fabric and dynamic multi-tier router coordinating kernel sandboxing, hardware microVMs, and biometric credential injection.

item_4ded55ccac76b274.title: Django9944/oss-starter-template
item_4ded55ccac76b274.summary: AI-native software engineering open-source project starter template (README, VISION, AGENTS, SECURITY, Issue/PR guards & Actions).

item_e0f989885da6f444.title: hongrenw111-debug/geo-shield
item_e0f989885da6f444.summary: Anti-GEO soft-ad detector, indirect prompt-injection sanitizer, AI memory-poisoning URL inspector, MCP server & audit dashboard

item_42a25a5252c0fb33.title: qiuliang-liangqiu/pi-deepseek
item_42a25a5252c0fb33.summary: pi-agent workbench 是一个跑在 pi 上的 CTF / 靶场智能体。它的特点不是"提示词写得好"，而是把纪律做成机器能执行的东西：15 分钟无新原语触发停滞闸门、20 req/s 令牌桶、triage 30 分钟强制浅指纹、完成判据只认 is_completed/flag_total、所有 tool_result 过 prompt-injection 扫描。

item_1a5eb0cbbb84b14b.title: Tejascodz/pramana
item_1a5eb0cbbb84b14b.summary: Open-source AI assurance engine: audits ML models, LLM apps and AI agents for fairness, drift, privacy, prompt injection and identity spoofing, and seals the evidence in a signed, hash-chained pack mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act. Validated on ProPublica's COMPAS data.

item_537dd1288f1c2c08.title: islemfarhat1/PromptShield
item_537dd1288f1c2c08.summary: Experimental study of prompt injection detection and cross-dataset generalization using ML and DistilBERT

item_02c157478e64dbe7.title: rollingedition/book-securing-llm-applications-and-agents
item_02c157478e64dbe7.summary: How an assistant with tools and data is turned against its users, and which defences measurably stop it: prompt injection, exfiltration, tool misuse and third-party code, on a property office's assistant.

item_f29022c82bbe6a15.title: tuxevil/tuxevil-benchmark
item_f29022c82bbe6a15.summary: tuxevil-benchmark is a self-hosted benchmarking & red-teaming platform for local SLMs. Measure TTFT, tok/s, & latency while an automated frontier LLM judge evaluates accuracy, grammar, & prompt injection resilience in real time.

item_81aaf5e64e5b9bc0.title: multikernel/sandlock
